description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Riku of Two Reflections' second ability trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Elspeth, Storm Slayer that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Riku of Two Reflections' second ability trigger, causing you to pay {G}{U} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Elspeth, Storm Slayer tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
